verdicts.human_summary: DOM text (title attribute) is reinterpreted as HTML via .html() without escaping meta-characters, creating an XSS vulnerability
verdicts.reasoning: None of the AI comments address the security/XSS concern about DOM text being passed unsanitized to .html(). The AI comments focus on duplicate elements, styling, theming, positioning, type errors, and missing tests — but none identify the HTML injection vulnerability at line 512 where the title attribute value is interpreted as HTML.
